query.description: Words to find; every word must appear (English stems match). May be empty when a filter is given

filters.description: Narrow by session or message fields. Each key takes one value or a list (any of); every key given must hold

repo_name.description: Sessions in these repositories: host/org/repo, or an unambiguous short name

user_email.description: Sessions run by these members (exact email)

tool_name.description: Messages calling or answering these tools, such as Read or Bash

file_prefix.description: Sessions that touched a file whose path starts with this text, such as src/auth/

file_operation.description: Sessions where a file was read, edited, written or deleted; with file_prefix, the same file must match both

since.description: Messages at or after this UTC time (inclusive)

where.description: Up to 10 extra conditions that must all hold, on a message field (tool_name, tool_use_id, content, role, kind, model, or a JSON path inside tool_input) or a session field (harness, title, repo_name, branch, user_email, status)

field.description: Field to test. Message fields: tool_name, tool_use_id, content, role, kind, model, tool_input (JSON, needs path). Session fields: harness, title, repo_name, branch, user_email, status

path.description: JSON keys or array positions inside tool_input, such as ["file_path"]; only with field tool_input

oneOf.description: Exact, case-sensitive match; null matches a missing value. tool_input compares a JSON primitive with its type

context.description: Neighbouring non-thinking messages either side of each hit

limit.description: Hit messages per page; at most 3 hits per session

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page; null for the first page

session_id.description: Session the messages belong to; pass to get for the full transcript

root_session_id.description: Root of the session tree. Equals session_id unless the hit sits inside a subagent, fork or spawned run; open the root and read the run inline.

parent_relation.description: How this session relates to its parent; null for a root session.

agent_type.description: Harness agent type of a subagent run, when the harness reports one.

parent_tool_use_id.description: The parent's tool call that spawned this run, when recorded and the parent is visible; null for a root session.
